sourceChecks.text: The LORD said to Samuel, “How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him from being king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go. I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided a king for myself among his sons.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 主がサムエルをベツレヘム人エッサイのもとへ送り、その子らの中から王を選ぶと告げる。

sourceChecks.text: Call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do. You shall anoint to me him whom I name to you.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: サムエルはエッサイとその子らをいけにえに招くよう告げる。

sourceChecks.text: He said, “Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to the LORD. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice.” He sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エッサイとその子らがいけにえに招かれる。

sourceChecks.text: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. He said, “The LORD has not chosen this one, either.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エッサイが息子たちをサムエルの前に進ませる。

sourceChecks.text: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, “The LORD has not chosen this one, either.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エッサイが息子たちをサムエルの前に進ませる。

sourceChecks.text: Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. Samuel said to Jesse, “The LORD has not chosen these.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エッサイが息子たちをサムエルの前に進ませる。

sourceChecks.text: Samuel said to Jesse, “Are all your children here?” He said, “There remains yet the youngest. Behold, he is keeping the sheep.” Samuel said to Jesse, “Send and get him, for we will not sit down until he comes here.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エッサイは末の子が羊の番をしていると答える。

sourceChecks.text: Then one of the young men answered and said, “Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite who is skillful in playing, a mighty man of valor, a man of war, prudent in speech, and a handsome person; and the LORD is with him.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: サウルの家臣がエッサイの子の一人を紹介する。

sourceChecks.text: Therefore Saul sent messengers to Jesse, and said, “Send me David your son, who is with the sheep.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文でダビデがエッサイの子と明記される。

sourceChecks.text: Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a container of wine, and a young goat, and sent them by David his son to Saul.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文でダビデがエッサイの子と明記される。

sourceChecks.text: Saul sent to Jesse, saying, “Please let David stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文でダビデがエッサイの子と明記される。

sourceChecks.text: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehem Judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons. The man was an elderly old man in the days of Saul.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がエッサイをダビデの父として名指す。

sourceChecks.text: The three oldest sons of Jesse had gone after Saul to the battle; and the names of his three sons who went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next to him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がエッサイをダビデの父として名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Jesse said to David his son, “Now take for your brothers an ephah of this parched grain and these ten loaves, and carry them quickly to the camp to your brothers;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がエッサイをダビデの父として名指す。

sourceChecks.text: David rose up early in the morning and left the sheep with a keeper, and took the provisions and went, as Jesse had commanded him. He came to the place of the wagons as the army which was going out to the fight shouted for the battle.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がエッサイをダビデの父として名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Saul said to him, “Whose son are you, you young man?” David answered, “I am the son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がエッサイをダビデの父として名指す。

sourceChecks.text: On the next day after the new moon, the second day, David’s place was empty. Saul said to Jonathan his son, “Why didn’t the son of Jesse come to eat, either yesterday, or today?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がダビデを「エッサイの子」と呼ぶ。

sourceChecks.text: Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がダビデを「エッサイの子」と呼ぶ。

sourceChecks.text: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you will not be established, nor will your kingdom. Therefore now send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die!”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がダビデを「エッサイの子」と呼ぶ。

sourceChecks.text: Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you fields and vineyards? Will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds?
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がダビデを「エッサイの子」と呼ぶ。

sourceChecks.text: Is that why all of you have conspired against me, and there is no one who discloses to me when my son makes a treaty with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you who is sorry for me, or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がダビデを「エッサイの子」と呼ぶ。

sourceChecks.text: Then Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, answered and said, “I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がダビデを「エッサイの子」と呼ぶ。

sourceChecks.text: Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread, and a sword, and have inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がダビデを「エッサイの子」と呼ぶ。

sourceChecks.text: Nabal answered David’s servants and said, “Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants who break away from their masters these days.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がダビデを「エッサイの子」と呼ぶ。
